prerequisites: Basic understanding of operating systems and computer architectures
Ability to operate on Unix systems

learning_outcomes.text: Basic knowledge on architecture and protocols of computer networks. The focus is on the TCP/IP protocol stack.
Know-how that allows the deployment of main network services based on Linux/Unix systems as well as network security.
Knowledge and understanding of the principles related to the computer networks and network applications.
Ability to use the main application of computer networks.
Ability to install and configure local networks in a UNIX/Linux environment.
Ability to develop simple network applications.
Ability to implement simple security policies in a networking environment.

syllabus_topics: IP level: Autonomous systems, Internet routing algorithms, router architecture
Domain Name System: name servers, resource records, resolution modes, zones
Transport level: theory, UDP protocol, TCP protocol, congestion control
World Wide Web: client, server, HTTP protocol, URL
Network configuration and analysis in GNU/Linux systems
Socket programming in C and Python

assessment_methods.method: Written test with open and multiple choice questions
Lab test concerning Web development, network configuration and network programming

assessment_rules: Both the written test and the lab test must be completed successfully. The final grade is based on a weighted average of the results of the written test (2/3) and lab test (1/3). Tests can take place live or online, supervised by the teacher or collaborators.
bibliography: "Reti di Calcolatori" Andrew S. Tanenbaum, David J. Wetherall, e al. Pearson
institution: Università degli Studi di Modena e Reggio Emilia — Ingegneria Informatica (MO)
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica (Mo) (Computer Engineering (D.M.270/04)), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
